Admission exam:

During the oral examination, candidates will be asked to explain the motivations
that lead them to undertake a PhD in Neuroscience, and to concisely expose their
scientific interests in this field. During the exam, candidates will also discuss their
submitted Research Project, which should be based on 1-2 research lines
proposed by the Academic Board of the PhD in Neuroscience and described in
Examination topics
the Course website (https://pnc.unipd.it/phd-neuroscience/phd-research-lines/).
The Admission Committee will also discuss with the candidate her/his CV and
qualifications. Finally, for those who will also apply for Priority Research-bonded
fellowships, part of the oral examination will be dedicated to verify the suitability of
the candidate for the chosen theme/s.
